Definition: neuter of a presumed compound of G4314 and G2776; something for the head, i.e. a cushion:--pillow.
BiblicalUsage: Proskephalaion means a pillow, something for the head. It appears once, in the storm on the sea: Jesus was in the hinder part of the ship, asleep on a pillow, while the waves beat into the ship.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that His sleep is my comfort: the storm was real, and so was His rest, because the wind and the sea were His to command.
